core_values.name: class_struggle
core_values.desc: conflict between working class and bourgeoisie shapes history

core_values.name: collective_ownership
core_values.desc: means of production should be owned and controlled collectively

core_values.name: equality
core_values.desc: eliminate class distinctions and material inequality

core_values.name: worker_control
core_values.desc: workers should control production and decision-making

core_values.name: solidarity
core_values.desc: unity of working people across borders against exploitation

key_definitions.definition: social groups defined by relationship to means of production (workers vs owners)
appropriation of surplus value produced by workers by capital owners
value created by workers beyond what they receive in wages
factories, land, machinery, capital used to produce goods
private ownership of means of production enables exploitation
capital-owning class that extracts surplus value from workers
working class that sells labor power to survive
workers' separation from their labor, products, and fellow workers under capitalism
transitional period where workers control state to reorganize society
classless, stateless society based on common ownership and 'from each according to ability, to each according to need'

assumed_principles.name: workers_control
assumed_principles.desc: democratic control of production by workers themselves

assumed_principles.name: class_struggle_as_engine_of_change
assumed_principles.desc: social progress comes through organized class conflict

assumed_principles.name: equality_through_redistribution
assumed_principles.desc: redistribute wealth and power to eliminate class divisions

warrants.name: labor_theory_of_value
warrants.desc: value derives from labor; profit is extracted surplus

warrants.name: state_as_class_tool
warrants.desc: state serves ruling class interests under capitalism

warrants.name: collective_efficiency
warrants.desc: planned production can eliminate waste and serve needs

decision_rule.notes: Evaluate by outcomes for working class; class interests serve as guide

policy_heuristics.default: abolish private property in means of production; establish common ownership
extensive redistribution to eliminate class inequality
workers' democracy; control over production and social decisions
replace markets with democratic planning to meet human needs
freedom for workers; restrictions on capitalist propaganda and counter-revolution
solidarity across borders; workers have no country

edge_cases.note: temporary worker state necessary to reorganize economy
acceptable as transitional stage, but full socialization is goal
true freedom requires liberation from capitalist exploitation; collective control enables individual flourishing
workers' democracy requires debate, but counter-revolutionary activity threatens gains
